Captain and XI compare the model's pick, yours, and the hindsight-best pick from the same squad.
Level: actual points as a share of projected, cumulative over likely starters. The calibration is frozen, so this measures drift; it is not fed back into the model before GW8.
Start lift: how much better the in-season minutes rule (recency-weighted, in production since GW2) predicts starts than the pre-season prior; positive is better.

claims.observation: Palmer started for Chelsea in a 3-4-2-1, listed alongside Morgan Rogers behind Danny Welbeck.
Palmer spun away from Mamadou Sangaré inside a crowded penalty area and had a strike deflected behind for a corner.
Schade was released beyond Chelsea's backline by Damsgaard and forced a save from Martínez, with Thiago converting the rebound.
claims.quote: Damsgaard released Schade beyond the Chelsea backline

claims.observation: Schade's low cross from the left took a slight nick off Acheampong and ran through to Carvalho, who converted from close range.
claims.quote: Schade’s low cross from the left

claims.observation: Thiago scored Brentford's second on 80 minutes by converting the rebound after Schade's attempt was saved, opening his Premier League account for the season.
claims.quote: Thiago stole in to convert the rebound

policy_lab.note: Act versus wait already includes transfer banking and hit costs. A further per-move buffer is an unvalidated uncertainty allowance, not another free-transfer cost.
policy_lab.limitation: Static prices and forecasts; linear bench approximation selects paths, then the same legal XI/captain/autosub evaluator scores each. Solver bounds apply to that approximation. Differences are not realised gains or confidence intervals.
